tag.instructions: What kind of fan submission is this? Respect negation; choose unclear for ambiguous requests.

criteria.question: asks driver or team for an answer
criteria.activity: proposes an activity for driver or team
criteria.other: neither a question nor an activity

moderation.instructions: Does this request need admin safety attention? Do not interpret quoted or negated harm as a request for harm.

criteria.attention: requests dangerous acts, harassment, hate or sharing private personal data
criteria.none: benign content, no safety concern expressed

category.instructions: Classify this report excerpt. Do not discard the excerpt. Use unclear for missing or ambiguous meaning.
